result.question: What does Yahweh's word say to the man?

readings.answer: That his body shall never reach the tomb of his fathers.
readings.support: your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers

readings.answer: That he defied the LORD's word by returning to eat and drink where forbidden.
readings.support: Because you have defied the word of the LORD and have not kept the commandment that the LORD your God gave you | you went back and ate bread and drank water in the place where He told you not to do so

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly says, “your body shall never reach the tomb of your fathers,” which is a natural paraphrase of “Your body won’t be buried,” matching the key’s intended consequence.

This restates the offense included in “This is what the LORD says,” namely that he defied the LORD by returning to eat and drink where forbidden; the question does not specify focusing on the penalty rather than the cause.

result.reason: The LORD’s word here includes both the offense and the punishment, so the question allows different materially distinct answers.
